current_role: Chair and CEO of Turning Point USA (since September 2025)
summary: Erika Kirk, a former Miss Arizona USA and podcaster, became chair and CEO of Turning Point USA after her husband, co-founder Charlie Kirk, was assassinated in September 2025. She endorsed JD Vance for president in December 2025, and Trump named her to the Air Force Academy Board of Visitors in March 2026.
